title: Cannabidiol alleviates neuroinflammation and attenuates neuropathic pain via targeting FKBP5.
authors: Wang, Xue; Lin, Cong; Jin, Sha; Wang, Yibo; Peng, Yinghua; Wang, Xiaohui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CBD通过靶向FKBP5缓解神经炎症和神经病理性疼痛，属于小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，也无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Microglia is a heterogeneous population that mediates neuroinflammation in the central nervous system (CNS) and plays a crucial role in developing neuropathic pain. FKBP5 facilitates the assembly of the IkappaB kinase (IKK) complex for the activation of NF-kappaB, which arises as a novel target for treating neuropathic pain. In this study, cannabidiol (CBD), a main active component of Cannabis, was identified as an antagonist of FKBP5. In vitro protein intrinsic fluorescence titration showed that CBD directly bound to FKBP5. Cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) indicated that CBD binding increased the FKBP5 stability, which implies that FKBP5 is the endogenous target of CBD. CBD was found to inhibit the assembly of the IKK complex and the activation of NF-kappaB, therefore blocking LPS-induced NF-kappaB downstream pro-inflammatory factors NO, IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha. Stern-Volmer analysis and protein thermal shift assay revealed that tyrosine 113 (Y113) of FKBP5 was critical for FKBP5 interacting with CBD, which is consistent with in silico molecular docking simulation. FKBP5 Y113 mutation (Y113A) alleviated the effect of CBD inhibiting LPS-induced pro-inflammatory factors overproduction. Furthermore, systemic administration of CBD inhibited chronic constriction injury (CCI)-induced microglia activation and FKBP5 overexpression in lumbar spinal cord dorsal horn. These data imply that FKBP5 is an endogenous target of CBD.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞是一种异质性细胞群体，介导中枢神经系统（CNS）中的神经炎症，并在神经病理性疼痛的发展中发挥关键作用。FKBP5促进IkappaB激酶（IKK）复合物的组装以激活NF-kappaB，这成为治疗神经病理性疼痛的新靶点。在本研究中，大麻二酚（CBD），一种大麻的主要活性成分，被鉴定为FKBP5的拮抗剂。体外蛋白质内在荧光滴定显示CBD直接结合FKBP5。细胞热位移分析（CETSA）表明CBD结合增加了FKBP5的稳定性，这暗示FKBP5是CBD的内源性靶点。研究发现CBD抑制IKK复合物的组装和NF-kappaB的激活，从而阻断LPS诱导的NF-kappaB下游促炎因子NO、IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha。Stern-Volmer分析和蛋白质热位移分析揭示FKBP5的酪氨酸113（Y113）对CBD与FKBP5的相互作用至关重要，这与计算机分子对接模拟一致。FKBP5 Y113突变（Y113A）减轻了CBD抑制LPS诱导的促炎因子过度产生的作用。此外，全身性给予CBD抑制了慢性缩窄性损伤（CCI）诱导的腰脊髓背角小胶质细胞激活和FKBP5过表达。这些数据表明FKBP5是CBD的内源性靶点。
